name: praxis-sound-app
description: Praxis Sound workstation front end: the desktop shell's UI, the browser build on the WebAssembly engine, and a mock engine for UI tests.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p praxis-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/engine-wasm/pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/praxis_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:web: npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode web
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && cargo run -p praxis-wasm --example native_render -- ../target/praxis-native/acceptance1.f32 && playwright test -c tests/web/playwright.config.ts
